pluginDevelopment.helpIntro: Describe what you need. Situate can add or change tools (plugins), connections and files in this workspace.
pluginDevelopment.helpLeaving: Return to this chat from Conversations. Work continues when you close the chat. Closing the workspace or quitting Situate stops it. Send a message to continue interrupted work.
pluginDevelopment.helpScope: Open Changes to compare files before and after edits. Find other workspace files in Files.
pluginDevelopment.helpSafety: File edits are saved as work happens, even if plugin checks fail. Situate checks new or changed plugins before putting them into use. Test data is not carried over. You may still need to connect an account or grant access.
